LanguageData.PDX_DiplomaticSeal.label: diplomatic seal
LanguageData.PDX_DiplomaticSeal.description: A stamped token used by low-technology factions to certify a prisoner agreement. It is valuable mainly because the issuing faction recognizes it.
LanguageData.PDX_EncryptedDiplomaticLedger.label: encrypted diplomatic ledger
LanguageData.PDX_EncryptedDiplomaticLedger.descriptio: A hardened data ledger containing authenticated trade warrants and diplomatic credit records. Its value depends on the issuing faction honoring the embedded signatures.
